recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Reintroducing the original broader invariant would conflict with FHIR-17185; any future change to the scope of absolute type-code URLs should be handled as a new FHIR-I decision rather than as a FHIR-12245 fixup.
issue_request: FHIR-12245 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 and requested that ElementDefinition.type.code become uri, reference canonical StructureDefinitions, treat relative references as relative to http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition, and restrict non-logical StructureDefinitions to relative/FHIR-defined type references.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git-svn commit f632a5f6862e53cac15952040d46197658a517be (SVN r10013), which changed ElementDefinition.type.code from code to uri, added the StructureDefinition-relative URL wording, and added the original custom-types-only-in-logical-models invariant.
additional_context: Later FHIR-17185 deliberately revised sdf-19 so it applies to FHIR-originated/core StructureDefinitions rather than all externally authored StructureDefinitions. Later ElementDefinition.type.code work such as FHIR-22670 and FHIR-35769 is already represented on the combined branch and did not require a duplicate decision here.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active ElementDefinition source defines type.code as uri and documents relative StructureDefinition references plus the logical-model absolute-URL exception. The active StructureDefinition source retains sdf-19 for FHIR specification models, consistent with the later FHIR-17185 narrowing.

related_jiras.note: Published later decision narrowed sdf-19 so the custom-type restriction applies to FHIR-originated/core StructureDefinitions, explaining the current invariant scope.
Later ElementDefinition.type.code binding clarification already has a combined-branch audit commit.
Later fhir-type extension clarification references ElementDefinition.type.code and already has a combined-branch audit commit.
